units.title: Organize Writing: Introductions, Transitions and Conclusions
skills: Write an introduction that tells the topic
Link ideas with transitions such as for example, also and because
Group related information together
Write a conclusion that sums up the main idea
vocab: introduction
the beginning that tells the reader the topic
topic sentence
the sentence that states the main idea of a paragraph
transition
a word or phrase that links ideas, such as for example or in addition
supporting detail
a fact, example or reason that explains the main idea
paragraph
a group of sentences about one main idea
conclusion
the ending that sums up the main idea

passage.title: Desert Foxes
passage.intro: Talal is writing a report about the fennec fox. Read his draft and answer the questions.
paras: (1) The fennec fox is the smallest fox in the world. (2) It lives in the deserts of North Africa. (3) Its huge ears help it hear insects moving under the sand.
